title: TimePeriodCompact
description:
Full object requires scope: time_periods:read

A generic Asana Resource, containing a globally unique identifier.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the resource, as a string.

resource_type.description: The base type of this resource.

end_on.description: The localized end date of the time period in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

start_on.description: The localized start date of the time period in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

period.description: The cadence and index of the time period.

display_name.description: A string representing the cadence code and the fiscal year.
